description:
One row of the founder's review queue: an assessment awaiting sign-off, with enough context
to open it. Computed, never stored — the queue is derived from requests and approvals.

advisor_email.description: How to reach them about it.
advisor_email.title: Advisor Email

changed_sections.description: For a re-review of a client report: which of the six sections differ from the version the founder last approved. Empty on a first review, where everything is new.
changed_sections.title: Changed Sections

deliverable_id.description: The deliverable whose client report awaits sign-off; null for an assessment.
deliverable_id.title: Deliverable Id

document_hash.description: Current hash of the document to be approved.
document_hash.title: Document Hash

owner_consultant_id.description: The consultant who owns this resource. Data scoping is by this field, enforced in the repository layer and tested from day one.
owner_consultant_id.title: Owner Consultant Id

previously_approved.description: True when this assessment carries an approval at an older hash, meaning it was signed off and then edited. The founder is re-reviewing, not reviewing.
previously_approved.title: Previously Approved

title: FounderReviewQueueEntry
